text: The models directory holds blobs/ with content-addressed files named by digest with ':' replaced by '-' (sha256-<64 hex>), and manifests/ with per-tag JSON, e.g. manifests/registry.ollama.ai/library/gemma3/270m. Blobs are shared by digest, so tags with the same weights layer share one file. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama model registry and library tags and on-disk blob and manifest storage

text: A manifest is schemaVersion 2 with Docker mediaType application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json, a config (application/vnd.docker.container.image.v1+json) and layers typed application/vnd.ollama.image.model, .template, .license and .params. (low confidence)
keywords: Ollama model registry and library tags and on-disk blob and manifest storage

text: Current main source defines two manifest roots under the models dir: legacy 'manifests' and new 'manifests-v2' (canonical host ollama.com). Lookup tries a digest reference, then manifests-v2, then legacy candidates; removal deletes both. Older releases only use manifests/. Layer blobs are hashed with sha256 and written via temp file 'sha256-*' in blobs/. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama model registry and library tags and on-disk blob and manifest storage

text: Ollama manifests reuse the Docker image manifest v2 schema 2 envelope (schemaVersion 2, mediaType, a config object and a layers array whose entries carry mediaType, size and sha256 digest); Ollama substitutes its own layer media types (model, template, license, params) for image layers. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama model registry and library tags and on-disk blob and manifest storage

text: Digest mismatch on pull has several reported causes: proxy ignoring Range requests, missing Content-Length yielding an empty file (sha256 e3b0c442...), disk full or short write, local memory/storage faults (got digest changes each attempt), and an existing corrupt blob accepted as a cache hit by downloadBlob(). (low confidence)
keywords: Ollama model registry and library tags and on-disk blob and manifest storage

text: Default model directory: ~/.ollama/models on macOS, /usr/share/ollama/.ollama/models on Linux with the standard installer, C:\Users\%username%\.ollama\models on Windows. Setting OLLAMA_MODELS overrides it; on Linux the ollama service user needs read/write access to the new directory. (high confidence)
keywords: Ollama model registry and library tags and on-disk blob and manifest storage

text: Unqualified model names resolve against defaults host registry.ollama.ai, namespace library, tag latest (defaultHost/defaultNamespace/defaultTag in the name parser). (high confidence)
keywords: Ollama model registry and library tags and on-disk blob and manifest storage

text: User models take the form <ollama.com username>/<model>; ollama cp renames a local model to that namespace and ollama push publishes it after an Ollama public key is added. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama model registry and library tags and on-disk blob and manifest storage

text: Copying only manifests or only blobs between machines breaks the model; both subdirectories must travel together. (low confidence)
keywords: Ollama model registry and library tags and on-disk blob and manifest storage
